title: Single-book prop lines are shown with a 'fair' price that is just that book's own de-vigged price
steps: Run `cd sigmaline && npx tsx tickets/evidence/PNHL-pipeline-script.ts` (synthetic fake NHL event, 4 fresh fake books plus one book 45 min old).
Look at 'Fake Solo Over/Under 1.5 Points' (one book) and 'Over 4.5 Shots on goal' (one book).
expected: Rows backed by one book show no fair price or are hidden (nothing to compare against); README says no fair price means no row.
actual: Rows are kept in the feed with books=1, fairSource=consensus, fair 2.000 / EV -5.0% (the book's own margin). Grade is correctly none. The Props tab would show 'fair +100' and '1 books · consensus-only' as if it were a market fair price.
suspected_area: packages/core/src/pricing.ts / feed.ts: no min-books requirement for display; also prop-row.tsx prints '{books} books' without singular
